how: rung bv (a file on the volume's XFS at VOL_MNT, as rung b on the loop; set beside boot 8's b 7.6/3.9 and a 3.5/1.0 ms a write): dd if=/dev/zero bs=4096 count=1000 oflag=dsync, pass 1 a fresh file (cv: in place), pass 2 the same file with conv=notrunc; sync, then /proc/diskstats before and after each: per role (the root disk, its partition, the volume) writes, ms writing, flushes (column 19), ms flushing (column 20), ms a flush; boot 8's loop path, ms a write fresh/rewrite: a 3.5/1.0 (the root ext4), b 7.6/3.9 (XFS on the loop), c 8.3/4.0 (a reflink copy on it), d 19.8/8.4 (a guest under Writeback)

name: ladder_cv
how: rung cv (a reflink copy of a 5 GiB fallocated file on the volume, its first 64 MiB written before the copy (a reflink shares written extents alone), written in place at its first shared extent of 1000 blocks or more (seek_block), as rung c on the loop; set beside boot 8's c 8.3/4.0 ms a write): dd if=/dev/zero bs=4096 count=1000 oflag=dsync, pass 1 a fresh file (cv: in place), pass 2 the same file with conv=notrunc; sync, then /proc/diskstats before and after each: per role (the root disk, its partition, the volume) writes, ms writing, flushes (column 19), ms flushing (column 20), ms a flush; boot 8's loop path, ms a write fresh/rewrite: a 3.5/1.0 (the root ext4), b 7.6/3.9 (XFS on the loop), c 8.3/4.0 (a reflink copy on it), d 19.8/8.4 (a guest under Writeback)

name: ladder_dv
how: rung dv, in the guest of F-w's first lease (Writeback, frozen, Sync, its disk a reflink copy on the volume) over the lease's ssh, after its quiet idle read and before its load: dd of 1000 dsync 4 KiB writes to /var/tmp, pass 1 a fresh file, pass 2 conv=notrunc; vda's diskstats in the same session; before each pass the guest's own sync in a call of its own, then around the pass's call the host's root disk and volume lines and vmmetrics, the VMM's block_rootfs.flush_count summed; vmm_idle, the VMM's flushes over 15 s with nothing run before the rung; write_cache and the flush feature bit; set beside boot 8's d 19.8/8.4 ms a write (7.2 ms a vda flush on the rewrite, 90% of it two loop flushes) and a 3.5/1.0; a guest flush under about 4 ms is half of what decides (4.3b); boot 8's loop path, ms a write fresh/rewrite: a 3.5/1.0 (the root ext4), b 7.6/3.9 (XFS on the loop), c 8.3/4.0 (a reflink copy on it), d 19.8/8.4 (a guest under Writeback)
